description: This file provides security primitives such as password hashing using bcrypt and JWT token creation and validation utilities, including functions for creating access tokens, decoding tokens, and extracting subjects.

methods.name: str hash_password(password: str)
methods.description: Hash a plaintext password using bcrypt.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str)
methods.description: Verify a plaintext password against a stored bcrypt hash.

methods.name: str create_access_token(subject: str, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None, extra_claims: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Create a signed JWT access token with optional expiration and extra claims.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] decode_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decode and validate a JWT token, raising an error if invalid or expired.

methods.name: Optional[str] try_get_subject(token: str)
methods.description: Attempt to extract the subject (user ID) from a JWT token, returning None if invalid.

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(subject: str, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None, extra_claims: Optio/
ctags.signature: (subject: str, expires_minutes: Optional[int] = None, extra_claims: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
